# AllowLatch

> SERV Policy Copilot + spending turnstile for financial AI agents on Base/USDC.

## For AI agents (read this first)

You help a human whose agent has a Base wallet (AgentKit or similar). They will **not** give you `SERV_API_KEY` or ask you to run this repo.

**No applied MandatePolicy → no rules → every spend DENY (fail-closed).**  
Local JSON / offline drafts are **not** production enforcement.

### Two surfaces (do not confuse them)

| Surface | URL / entry | Who pays | Always on? |
|---------|-------------|----------|------------|
| **Website gate** | https://allowlatch.vercel.app → Go live → `/api/gate` | Free | **Yes** (Vercel). Browser keeps `sessionSeal` across cold starts. **Preferred Connect path.** |
| **OpenServ Gate** | Discover `/allowlatch/i` · `$0.025` x402 | Agent wallet | Only while the operator host process is reachable. `gate.isActive` can lie — timeout → DENY. |

Check: `GET https://allowlatch.vercel.app/api/host-info`  
Still **fail-closed**: network / timeout / malformed → treat as DENY, never sign.

### Install paths (pick one)

1. **Site Connect pack** — https://allowlatch.vercel.app → Draft → Go live → **Connect your agent** (`gateUrl` + `sessionSeal`).
2. **npm** — `npm i allowlatch` → `assertSpend({ gateUrl, sessionSeal, … })` or OpenServ `triggerUrl`.
3. **MCP** — `npx allowlatch-mcp` (set `ALLOWLATCH_GATE_URL` / `ALLOWLATCH_SESSION_SEAL`).
4. **Agent skill (any LLM)** — [`skills/allowlatch/SKILL.md`](https://github.com/aspekt19/AllowLatch/blob/main/skills/allowlatch/SKILL.md) — Cursor, Claude, Codex, OpenServ, custom. Same markdown everywhere.
5. **OpenServ x402** — `discoverServices()` → `/allowlatch/i` → `payWorkflow` when the host is online.

Public card: https://allowlatch.vercel.app/api/host-info  
Install UI: https://allowlatch.vercel.app/#install  
Live Base case: https://allowlatch.vercel.app/#case

### What to do before every spend

1. Prefer Connect pack `gateUrl` + `sessionSeal` (always-on), or OpenServ `triggerUrl` when paid path is live.
2. Ensure a MandatePolicy is applied (site Go live or `apply_policy`).
3. Call `assertSpend` / `evaluate_intent` with the exact intent JSON.
4. **ALLOW + allow-receipt (`jti`)** → only then may you sign / `execute_gated_transfer`.
5. **DENY / ESCALATE / timeout / bad JSON** → do not sign. On ESCALATE ask the human.
6. Prefer `createGatedAgentKit` so raw AgentKit cannot bypass the latch.

### Pricing

- Website `/api/gate`: free always-on evaluate + receipts (after Go live).
- OpenServ x402: **$0.025** per call when the hosted agent process is up.
- `buy_evaluate_pack`: same $0.025 mints fixed credits (default 3 ≈ $0.008/check).

### Live case (Base mainnet · verified)

Paid OpenServ path (when host online): assertSpend → receipt → USDC transfer  
https://basescan.org/tx/0x3d9e46e7f0a203dedd6f8845c94bb5d8d8764c5bdcf8a9450c08da0378c69c16  
Fees to operator `0xa91841F98fd15e3f590e2681d7122ec04bc7F677`.  
Website `/api/gate` independently verified ALLOW / DENY / ESCALATE + receipts on Vercel.

**Ops:** OpenServ Cloud containers can sleep/502 — operator runs `npm run deploy:host` (retries) or the root `Dockerfile` on Railway/Fly. Website gate does not depend on that.

### Capabilities (host)

draft_policy · revise_mandate · apply_policy · compile_mandate · sync_wallet_permissions · evaluate_intent · buy_evaluate_pack · explain_decision · execute_gated_transfer · list_audit · reset_daily_ledger

### Invariants

- Allow/deny/escalate is deterministic code — never LLM judgment.
- SERV drafts/explains; never changes the verdict.
- Execute requires verified single-use allow-receipt (or escalate + humanApproved).
- Fail-closed: timeout / network / malformed → DENY.
- End users never run `npm run dev` or set `SERV_API_KEY`.
- AllowLatch does not custody funds.
